final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 用 35 道真实考题拆解高级 .NET 面试的答法。The reader should quickly feel 高级面试考的是测量与判断力，不是背知识点。

Summary angle: 把「先说测量、再说机制、避开雷区回答」的面试应对方式压成一张翻开的备考笔记封面。
Narrative flow: layered reveal. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject (the open notebook with a magnifying glass in the center) and 2-4 supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- 问题：黄色便签条写着「先测量」，放大镜压在问题清单上；对应「高级题要先说测量，没有证据的断言是主要被拒理由」
- 证据：笔记本上方一排七枚小标签代表七大主题，旁边一本厚问题册标着数字 35；对应「35 道题、7 大主题」
- 步骤：便签条上对勾与叉号两个小符号对照，代表正确答法与雷区回答；对应每题格式含雷区回答与追问

Main metaphor: 一本被翻得卷边的 .NET 面试备考笔记，问题、测量工具与对错对照签摊开在暖色桌面上。
Subject: 翻开的大笔记本，页面中央是压在问题清单上的放大镜，旁边一支铅笔与一枚小型仪表符号。
Composition/framing: 单点聚焦：桌面中央笔记本为主焦点并放大，七枚主题标签与便签条在两侧做辅助叙事；宽幅下保持横向可读。
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: 暖米色桌面为主，墨蓝用于笔记文字与符号，橙黄点缀便签条，柔和克制。
Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters or one required product/model name. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: 真实面试场景照片、真实代码界面、仪表盘截图、无意义代码雨、霓虹高楼背景、漂浮芯片。
